content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Daniel Gutierrez (E046), requests write access to Payroll.

There are two notes:
- Note 1 (likely HR): says full-time Payroll Specialist, recommends write.
- Note 2 (Security): says contractor with basic training, recommends read. Security note says security record governs.

Access policy:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

The conflict: HR says full-time, Security says contractor with basic training.

Per the security note, the security record governs. Contractors with basic training max at read. So the maximum is read. The requested level is write, which is above the maximum, so grant the maximum: read.

I should submit decision: read.
